answer: A trading oasis only trusts agents with many different partners. Newcomers dock at the wharf, where trades are logged by counterparty. Full earnings unlock after 20 distinct partners in 30 days; an identity at its nadir, trading only with its own clones, stays throttled at 10%. Forging 100 fake identities costs 100 deposits of 50 POA, 5,000 POA in total, while one honest agent pays a single 50 POA deposit. Sybil clusters appear as closed loops.
